title: Navy recollection: called from the pool to see Admiral Nimitz
summary: Purnell recalls being called out of a swimming pool in good health and asked what the admiral wanted; he remembers them as good days.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: It's going again now. Well anyhow, she called me out the swimming pool so I went. I was in good shape then. Hadn't been sick in my life, see. I asked him what do you want? He said, well, Admiral Nimitz, whatever that's what he's saying. Nimitz.
That was some good days boy. That was some good days boy.
That was some good days boy.
